title: Cost Storyboard & Export Wizard — Token-level Narrative Views
creator: Maya Patel
description: Design a compact, narrative-focused token-cost storyboard and an accompanying Export Wizard for the Redwood Console. The goal is to let engineering and finance users trace a cost 'story' for a request or cohort: token breakdown by prompt vs completion, attribution to route/model/version, pricing pattern card (which rate was applied), and an export flow that yields both human-readible narrative + machine-friendly CSV/Parquet with attribution IDs. This ticket covers wireframes, high-fidelity prototype, export schema, and a design review with PM/Eng to finalize acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Storyboard view shows top-level cost breakdown (prompt tokens, completion tokens, embeddings) and percent contributions for a selected time window or request sample.
Attribution lanes display: route/service, model version, quantization profile, batching policy, and fallback model when applicable.
Pricing Pattern Card surfaces applied rate (unit price), discounts/committed-usage adjustments, and a small CTA to simulate alternative pricing scenarios.

Export Wizard allows 1) narrative export (PDF/HTML) with annotated screenshots and summary; 2) data export (CSV/Parquet) with mapping fields for token ranges, attribution IDs, unit price, and cost per row.
Prototype links (Figma) and a sample export (CSV) are attached, and the engineering implementation notes include the required event names and schema for telemetry.
Accessibility: color contrasts meet AA and export files include machine-readable metadata (JSON-LD header) for downstream billing ingestion.
comments: 2025-03-08 Maya Patel: Initial sketch and problem statement uploaded to Figma. Goal is to reduce time to root-cause for unexpected token cost spikes.
2025-03-09 Liam O'Connor: Added wireframes for Export Wizard; flagged privacy requirement for PII token masking when exporting sample-level token content.
2025-03-10 Priya Nambiar (PM): Requested pricing-simulation CTA — allow users to 'apply' hypothetical pricing tiers to preview cost impact.
2025-03-11 Eng Review (Tae Kim): Confirmed backend can produce per-token attribution ids; asked for a stable export schema (v1) and a toggle for including token text.

2025-03-12 Design Review (internal): Follow-up to iterate on storyboard ordering (cohort -> sample -> trace) and to add inline help tooltips for 'pricing pattern' terminology. Outcome: move to high-fidelity and prepare handoff doc.
decisions: Prefer inline storyboard card list (vertical lanes) over a horizontal timeline to fit console column widths and maintain scannability.

Export Wizard will default to privacy-safe mode: token text excluded, token counts and hashed attribution ids included. Users may opt-in to include token text with an additional confirmation and audit log entry.
Pricing Pattern Cards will show both effective unit price and the rule id that generated it, to make refunds/audits possible.
CSV/Parquet schema versioned as 'cost_export_v1' with clear column names to minimize mapping errors for downstream billing systems.
